# Beoview Intercom for Home Assistant

> Unofficial Home Assistant add-on for Beoview / Golmar video intercoms with the BWCM.01 Wi-Fi module: doorbell
> entities, live video and two-way talk in a dashboard card, door unlock, quick replies, and blueprints to cast to
> a Google display or push to a phone. Setup is a photo of the module's QR code.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blacksuite/beoview-ha/main/README.md): overview, quick start, limits
- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blacksuite/beoview-ha/main/docs/installation.md): step by step
- [Set up with an AI assistant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blacksuite/beoview-ha/main/docs/ai-setup.md): prompt and verified checklist
- [The card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blacksuite/beoview-ha/main/docs/card.md): options, quick replies, remote access
- [Automations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blacksuite/beoview-ha/main/docs/automations.md): entities, blueprints, MQTT commands
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blacksuite/beoview-ha/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): log messages and fixes
